services.desc: Opening Friday, September 13th from 4:00-8:00pm at the Historic Courthouse Museum “The Watermen of Westmoreland County,” will coincide with this year’s theme of “The Power of Place” by the Northern Neck 250 Committee: “By prompting us to transcend political boundaries and delve more deeply into our past, the concept of “place” offers a unique perspective for fully understanding our history.” The water can act as a place of remembrance and reflection. It connects us to lands far away. But it also is a carrier of life that has sustained Westmoreland County through the labor of our watermen.
